description:
An undefeated legend right out of the gate, this girl is not simple! Shen Dong, once the strongest person in the sect, now just wants to live a peace, but the appearance of Xia Ri interrupts his peaceful life. This girl seems to be unruly, but on the inside she is kind and warm. Shen Dong is gradually touched by her influence... At the same time, the conflict between the four sects continues to escalate, and this time, new and old grudges are ended all together!

(Source: Bilibili)
